Calendar Context (either Retail or Standard). The Retail calendar is a weekly calendar knows as the 445 calendar. The Standard calendar is the daily Gregorian calendar. The Calendar Type has defaults if no selection is made. Retail Calendar is the default for POS and Retail Inventory data. Standard Calendar is the default for all other data (ex. Invoice, Open Orders, Estimates, etc.)
"Useful for grouping by Day of the Week, ex ""Monday"". Day of Week will be defined by the default or based on a filter selected in the Calendar Type dimension."
Month Name
"Useful for grouping by month abbreviated and year, ex. ""April 2021"". Month will be defined by the default or based on a filter selected in the Calendar Type dimension. For example
calculation: January for Invoice Sales or Standard Calendar is Jan 1 - Jan 31. January for POS Sales or the Retail Calendar is Week 1 - Week 4."

description: Quarter name (eaxmpale; QUARTER 1, QUARTER 2)
"Useful for grouping by quarter, ex. ""Q2 2021"". Quarter will be defined by the default or based on a filter selected in the Calendar Type dimension. For example
calculation: Quarter 1 for Invoice Sales or Standard Calendar is Jan 1 - Mar 31. Quarter 1 for POS Sales or the Retail Calendar is Week 1 - Week 13."

description: Date of transaction. Reporting Date definition may change depending on the fact selected. Sales-related Facts: Reporting Date is the date of the transaction. Open Order Facts: Reporting Date is the expected ship date. Order Intake Facts: Reporting Date is the Created On Date for Sales Document.
"Useful for grouping by week based on the 445 Calendar from Jan-Dec with Saturday Weekending, ex ""4/17/2021""
"Useful for grouping by year, ex. ""2021"". Year will be defined by the default or based on a filter selected in the Calendar Type dimension. For example
calculation: 2021 for Invoice Sales or Standard Calendar is Jan 1 - Jan 31. 2021 for POS Sales or the Retail Calendar is Week 1 - Week 52."

description: Time Periods are pre-baked collections of dates that can be used with most facts. Time Periods will always default to look backwards from the most recent refresh of data. Time Period will be defined by the default or based on a filter selected in the Calendar Type dimension. For example, YTD for Invoice Sales or Standard Calendar will include Jan 1 - Dec 31. YTD for POS Sales or the Retail Calendar will include Week 1 - Week 52.
